name: integrate-license
description: Wire a client software product into the PowerSoftware license system with the official zero-dependency SDK (Node/Python/Java): machine-code, trial, activation, edition gating, purchase redirect, update check.
descriptionZh: 用官方零依赖 SDK（Node/Python/Java）把客户端软件接入幂栈网授权体系：机器码、试用领取、激活、版本门控、购买页跳转、版本更新检查。
